summary: Tested iter44 nearest-position route insert, aerial types, aerial_override persistence, Excel Class column, and frontend map behaviors. Backend fully passes (4/4). Frontend flows (span list order, Aerial submenu, ug-class toggle & marker/color/footage effect, street toggle) all pass EXCEPT the SPAN MEASUREMENTS Reorder button which crashes JobMap with a ReferenceError.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking data-testid='span-reorder-btn' triggers 'Uncaught runtime error: combinedOrderItems is not defined' at JobMap line 2675. JobMap references combinedOrderItems() and saveSpanOrder as props to <SpanReorderList/>, but neither is defined/imported in JobMap.jsx (only spanReorder/savingOrder state exist). Reorder feature is completely non-functional — cannot open panel, cannot drag, cannot save.

action_items: Define combinedOrderItems() and saveSpanOrder in /app/frontend/src/pages/JobMap.jsx. combinedOrderItems should return a merged list of poles + underground items in current sort order, each with {id,type,label,sort_order}. saveSpanOrder(newItems) should PUT to /api/jobs/{job_id}/poles/reorder (or the existing bulk-reorder endpoint at jobs.py:251), then toast 'Route order updated', refresh state, and close the panel. Ensure error handling for saving failures.
Manually retest reorder drag+save after fix (dnd-kit activationConstraint distance>=5px).
critical_code_review_comments: JobMap.jsx line 2675 uses combinedOrderItems() and saveSpanOrder without any definition -> production crash the moment the reorder button is clicked; likely a partial commit.
JobMap.jsx WebSocket errors on localhost due to WDS_SOCKET_PORT=443 (frontend/.env) — non-blocking but noisy in dev.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted (soft/trash) TEST_ITER44 and TEST_ITER44_FE jobs via API for isolated testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in test_route_insert_and_aerial.py cover: options list, nearest-position insert (mid + append + no-GPS), aerial_override persistence, Excel Class column (with override winning). Frontend: span list correctly rendered as P1 to PI (UG), PI to PB (UG), PB to P2, and toggling a Handhole's Attribute Type -> Aerial correctly turns marker blue, removes (UG) tag, and shifts footage from underground to aerial (verified 401->292 UG, 255->365 aerial for a 109ft segment). Only Reorder panel crashes JobMap due to missing definitions.
rca of the issue: In /app/frontend/src/pages/JobMap.jsx around line 2675, <SpanReorderList initialItems={combinedOrderItems()} onSave={saveSpanOrder} .../> references two identifiers that are never declared in this file (grep shows only useState hooks for spanReorder/savingOrder). React throws ReferenceError: combinedOrderItems is not defined and unmounts JobMap. Reproduction: open any job map with >=2 items, click 'Reorder' button in SPAN MEASUREMENTS header. Fix: implement combinedOrderItems (merge poles + underground sorted by sort_order) and saveSpanOrder (PUT bulk-reorder endpoint then refresh + close panel + toast).
